summary: Accepted. The Kubernetes-native capability's behavior and stability dimensions are covered by three substantive cases. The CLI gate pins lifecycle-layer artifacts and version binding; the operator-feature command runs non-zero direct and operator tests that now assert both base and production composed Kustomize resources, the exact stateful topology, probes, PVC, Services/PDB, and connected security/backup wiring; and the real Kind gate checks reconciled resources before a PVC-backed queue/task mutation, pod-UID replacement, recovered state, post-recovery mutations, and verified cluster cleanup. The prior out-of-band direct-resource loophole is closed because both composed resource sets must contain the exact named Services and PDB.
